problems: Soum names were matched to geoBoundaries ADM2 within each aimag after converting both romanisations to a common skeleton (kh/h->x, ts->c, o/u/ö/ü merged, apostrophes removed); every match was unique within its aimag. Aliases: Zamiin-Uud = Zamyn U'ud, Shariin gol = Sharyngol, Ugtaal = Ugtaalcaidam, Khuvsgul = Hovsgel (ADM1); spelling match Bayan-Adarga = Bayan-Adraga.
